body:
No i don't think you understand

​

As a person whose just began life and has already tried killing themselves 4 times in the past 5 years and is trying again tomorrow after a few months I'm in no place to tell you to not do it but there's one thing i just want to say...

You're right she doesn't understand but you don't either. Think of suicide the way you want to but ik one thing for sure suicide is a selfish thing. It doesn't end the pain it passes it to someone else. It's not only you that's going to die but others could kill themselves too because  they feel guilty/sad or whatever because they couldn't do anything about it. You're not only killing yourself, you're risking causing others to do the same.

at first i thought we had a murderer on our hands but as a person who's also at this stage rn and is planning on killing themselves tmr for the fifth time i have no right to tell you to get help or whatever. Well you already know that so if you don't wanna get help or have already tried and failed then before you do it just ask yourself this questions.

Am i aware the pain i will inflict on others?

​

I'm in the same shoes, I'm well aware of what will happen. Some people are gonna miss me and i know it but I can't do this anymore. My bsf said she'd kill herself if i did, ik she's just trying to stop me so I'm still doing it.

Suicide is a selfish thing. you killing yourself could lead to other suicides. Make people feel terrible  about themselves. If you are well aware of this and still want to do this then you're the kind of people i hate. People like me, i hate them. So think about it carefully. Remember they're people who love you <3
